#{This algorithm dynamically penalizes tour edges proportionally via a temperature-scaled softmax Boltzmann weighting over utility values, applying continuous, adaptive edge-distance augmentations to escape local optima without stochastic or rigid threshold cutoffs.}

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    # Compute Guided Local Search utility of each edge in the tour
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    
    # Normalize utilities using Boltzmann/Softmax distribution with temperature scaling
    util_max = np.max(utilities)
    util_std = np.std(utilities)
    tau = util_std if util_std > 1e-8 else (np.mean(utilities) * 0.1 + 1e-8)
    
    exp_weights = np.exp((utilities - util_max) / tau)
    softmax_weights = exp_weights / np.sum(exp_weights)
    
    # Base penalty tied to mean edge length, scaled adaptively by softmax probability
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    n_edges = len(tour_lengths)
    
    # Continuous edge penalty proportional to relative softmax weight
    penalties = 0.3 * avg_edge * (softmax_weights * n_edges)
    
    # Symmetric vector update
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (u_idx, v_idx), penalties)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (v_idx, u_idx), penalties)
    
    return updated_edge_distance
